facebook: Player of the match: Thabo Mokoena! 🦁 Thabo hit a superb 112 off 118 balls, including 11 fours and 3 sixes, to anchor our 268/7 and set up a 34-run win over Kensington Ridge CC at Old Lions Oval. Proud doesn't begin to cover it. Well played, Thabo, and credit to Kensington Ridge for a good fight in Round 4 of the Premier League.

linkedin: Congratulations to Thabo Mokoena, player of the match for Old Lions 1st XI in our Premier League Round 4 win over Kensington Ridge CC. Thabo's 112 off 118 balls, with 11 fours and 3 sixes, anchored our 268/7 and helped secure a 34-run victory at Old Lions Oval. Thank you to everyone who came down to support the team, and to Kensington Ridge CC for a competitive contest.
gmb: Old Lions 1st XI beat Kensington Ridge CC by 34 runs in Premier League Round 4 at Old Lions Oval on Saturday, 31 October. Thabo Mokoena was named player of the match for his 112 off 118 balls, including 11 fours and 3 sixes.
